odometry_publisher.pose: worldPose(model) * offset; configured offset is identity
odometry_publisher.linear: world finite difference rotated into body frame, moving mean
odometry_publisher.angular: moving means of Euler RPY derivatives; adapter applies ZYX body-rate transform

smb_model: Derived at launch from installed gbplanner_smb/urdf/smb.urdf. Default compact preserves its chassis/wheels; explicit sensor_profile=upstream adds the pinned original head, both lidars and three camera physical bodies, including masses, inertias and collision solids.
physics_engine: Gazebo Fortress DART 6.12.1 solver with ODE collision detector selected by ign-physics 5.4.0
pointcloud: Native gpu_lidar PointCloudPacked via ros_gz_bridge. Compact:720x16 at5Hz. Upstream:VLP440x16 and OS1 440x32 at10Hz each, distinct frames/topics, strict per-sensor output range gates with invalid samples retained as NaN in organized layouts.
scope: Native ROS 2 simulator integration, not an equivalence claim against ROS 1 Gazebo Classic

native_mapping_run.shutdown_note: adapter received a second SIGINT during destruction; cleanup fixed after this run, subsequent native run must confirm normal exit
native_mapping_run.sensor_note: this run includes vehicle visual returns; render mask added afterward must be checked in next native run

self_returns.method: Native rendering visibility bits: five vehicle visuals use bit 4; lidar mask 0xfffffffb excludes only that bit
self_returns.native_evidence: results/fortress_autonomy/run2.json records masked native cloud during 3.54 m supervised travel

optional_contacts.semantics: Nonempty messages only; a silent sensor alone is not proof of no collision
optional_contacts.unobserved_fields: Fortress 6.18 emits entity IDs and contact positions but leaves normals/depths/wrenches empty in these runs. Empty arrays are unobserved, not zero force.

current_native_search_evidence: results/fortress_autonomy/run8.json (whole search + 1 local + homing passed; optional finite-slip tire model)

wheel_contact_configuration.effort_limit: No explicit upstream joint effort limit; native velocity interface uses the DART servo, not the separate Bullet 20 Nm motor implementation

simulation_clock_adapter.contract: simulated source and receipt ages govern Action liveness; delayed wall receipts stop motor commands while preserving an Action with fresh simulated state; service/action/stop deadlines and command expiry retain steady time
simulation_clock_adapter.scope: Synthetic clock/odometry with real ROS Actions; physical mission results separate

native_autonomy_evidence.calibration: Finite-slip simulation candidate, not measured SMB tire calibration

optional_wheel_slip.default_behavior: Original rigid upstream friction fields; no WheelSlip plugin
optional_wheel_slip.formula: primary slip [m/(N s)] = C_lateral * radius * abs(wheel spin) / nominal normal force
optional_wheel_slip.coefficient_basis: C_lateral=1 uses the installed official demonstration scale; not an SMB tire measurement or upstream value. Only this finite-slip candidate was run.
optional_wheel_slip.friction_basis: For the optional plugin only, rotate the real joint axis into collision coordinates: fdir1 = (0,0,-1). mu1=mu2=1 unchanged.
optional_wheel_slip.normal_force_basis: Static level-ground force/moment balance of original 60 kg masses and COM; not observed dynamic contact loads
optional_wheel_slip.unchanged: Original geometry, inertia, wheel joints, engine step, wheel radius/separation, speed limits, planner and endpoint/path thresholds
optional_wheel_slip.scope: Joint change of contact tangent basis and finite lateral slip; improvement cannot be attributed to the coefficient alone

observed_shutdown_fix.error: SIGINT context shutdown during take_message Contacts conversion in coverage10; mission completed before shutdown
observed_shutdown_fix.method: SignalHandlerOptions.NO, synchronous single-thread callback drain and executor/node/context shutdown in order
observed_shutdown_fix.scope: Separate short native load, original coverage10 status retained

rmf_obelix.dynamics: Four native MulticopterMotorModel plugins on original joints; unchanged pinned RotorS Lee core; no adapter pose integration
rmf_obelix.sensor: Original OS0 macro with 512x64 beams, 10 Hz requested, 360x90 degree FOV and base z offset .08 m
rmf_obelix.flight_evidence: results/fortress_rmf/flight2.json: whole native takeoff, 3-D flight, return, landing contact, zero motor command and orderly shutdown passed (27.33 s)
rmf_obelix.mapping_evidence: results/fortress_rmf/mission4.json: one start request, automatic takeoff, observed-map Extended root acceptance, home set, local + homing, native landing contact and stopped rotors; 21.156 m autonomous travel, 754232 known cells, 61.664 s wall elapsed

The preceding planning/x86 notes are historical scope statements, not new requirements.

post_run_changes.directed_check: results/fortress_rmf/pause_clock2.json; synthetic clock/odometry, 4 checks. Later mission4 used the fix; original autonomy4 three-cycle mission not rerun.
post_run_changes.pci_shutdown: results/control_shutdown/native.json; 4 actual ROS lifecycle checks, not physics

previous_three_cycle_evidence.summary: results/fortress_rmf/autonomy4.json: 3 local + homing actions, 51.263 m, home 2.594 mm, supervised landing; all four Actions succeeded
previous_three_cycle_evidence.scope: Three autonomous local actions and homing; takeoff and landing supervised. Original watchdog drop and shutdown warning remain in the run evidence; not rerun.

mission_entry.observer: tools/check_fortress_rmf_mission.py; one Trigger request, no trajectory publisher
mission_entry.takeoff_profile: Relative to native ground: +1 m in 4 s, hold 1 s, descend .2 m in 2 s to +.8 m; AIRBORNE only after the full profile and endpoint motion checks.

mission_entry.landing_services: land_srv (Empty) and rmf/land (Trigger); contact/rest-confirmed native landing then four zero motor commands

imu_runtime.pipeline: Three native Fortress IMUs at original mounts -> bridge -> source-effective stochastic adapters; no odometry synthesis.
imu_runtime.scope: Finite monotonic stamps, frames, motion, specific force and retained same-stamp differences/covariances checked. The two 500 Hz flight pair histories end before significant rotation; individual streams are separately checked during motion. Not noise-distribution, hardware or whole-stack parity validation.

post_mission_exact_gain_cache.scope: Implemented after mission4; two targeted checks plus one offline baseline/cached pair on its final map, no new physical flight.
post_mission_exact_gain_cache.result: Exact path, local/global graphs, score and draw count equality; single-pair plan 1197.433->1171.850 ms, absorb 1187.196->192.297 ms, total 2384.757->1364.267 ms, 286 cache hits. No statistical speedup claim.

smb_upstream_sensor_profile.source_chain: Fixed SMB sensor_head includes VLP-16 and OS1-64 (called with32 beams). Original smb_sim.launch relays both pointclouds into Voxblox; gain selects VLP16 only.
smb_upstream_sensor_profile.runtime_scope: Idle native dual-lidar scanning, TF, mapper fusion and planner accepted-map observation only. No commanded motion or planning/Action request. Natural spawning/settling observed.
smb_upstream_sensor_profile.snapshot_semantics: Mapper status, planner status/accepted map and latest mapper pointcloud are non-atomic observations at different moments, not a same-version cell difference. Distances are voxel centres from observed base_link, not lidar integration ray lengths.

earlier_failure.stage: Failed during model generation before simulation due to rejecting legitimate ament file symlinks.
earlier_failure.fix: Lexical package-relative path validation permits existing installed source symlinks; record results/smb_sensors/symlink_fix.json.

adaptations: OS1 original CPU ray becomes native GPU lidar.
Classic plugin applies noise between two open-interval range gates; native noise precedes the final ROS output gate. No RNG or exact near-limit rejection parity claim.
Original malformed VLP mesh node labels corrected only in separate copies.
Original camera joint/link name collisions resolved by renaming camera fixed joints only.

Camera bodies remain; RGB streams default off and are opt-in via cameras:=true, with separate static/runtime evidence in results/smb_cameras/checkpoint.json. OS1 IMU has separate evidence in results/smb_os1_imu/checkpoint.json.
Per-source mapper queues deliberately avoid cross-sensor equal-stamp rejection from the original merged ROS1 stream.
Scene .1m TSDF and ground projection remain; this is not a complete original .2m mapper/profile or physics equivalence.
smb_upstream_sensor_profile.prior_compact_exploration: Existing run8/run9/coverage10 remain compact evidence and were not rerun for this profile.

output_gate_branch.scope: Direct call to fortress_state.points using actual encoded PointCloud2 messages; no Node construction, simulator, mapper or native scan was started. Little-endian and big-endian cases each contain7 points;3 finite out-of-range points become XYZ NaN. In-range points, original NaN/Inf, non-XYZ bytes and source acquisition stamp remain preserved.

result.scope: Output range branch on encoded PointCloud2; no sensor or map simulation

output_gate_branch.native_scope: The recorded first12 matched cloud pairs for each sensor contained no native out-of-range return; this direct message branch check is separate evidence, not a native clipping event.

os1_imu_runtime.pipeline: Original mount -> native 100 Hz IMU -> bridge -> effective Hector noise -> /os1_cloud_node/imu; frame os1_imu.
os1_imu_runtime.scope: No motion/planning; samples at different times. Simulator processes cleaned up, child exit codes not retained.

smb_rgb_cameras.selection: cameras:=true requires sensor_profile:=upstream; disabled by default
smb_rgb_cameras.observed: Three native1440x1080RGB8 images;20.04Hz source-time,6.33-6.36Hz wall-time;40frames/camera; exact Image/CameraInfo stamps and optical TF verified; final nodes cleanly exited.
smb_rgb_cameras.camera_info: Only inferred stereo P[3] is cleared; raw native Info is retained and images are directly bridged. Original physical models unchanged.

services.calibrate: std_srvs/Empty: reset only gyro dynamic bias to zero

hector_runtime_interfaces.bias_topic: output_topic + /bias: sensor_msgs/Imu, same header, current dynamic drift + fixed offset for accel/rate, actual orientationError, zero covariance
hector_runtime_interfaces.preserved: No service-generated sample, timestamp reset, RNG draw or changes to drift/noise parameters
hector_runtime_interfaces.finite_request_adaptation: Nonfinite vectors are ignored and counted; original empty response has no success field
hector_runtime_interfaces.remaining: ROS1 dynamic_reconfigure wire protocol/UI is replaced by native ROS2 parameters; original RNG implementation/library bit parity is not claimed.

hector_dynamic_parameters.implementation: Native ROS 2 parameter services on gbplanner_rmf_imu_adapter; os0 and enabled smb_os1 streams
hector_dynamic_parameters.types: accel/rate: three doubles; yaw: one double
hector_dynamic_parameters.startup: Preserves loaded per-axis values and 1/3600 default frequency; cfg GUI defaults do not overwrite source model defaults
hector_dynamic_parameters.native_parameter_adaptation: Only named arrays/scalars change. Unlike ROS1 dynamic_reconfigure, an update does not broadcast all five scalar GUI values over all three axes. ROS1 wire protocol/UI are not emulated.
hector_dynamic_parameters.atomicity: Validate complete Hector-only batch before applying. Reject mixed non-Hector batches; static node parameters are read-only. Pure use_sim_time retains rclcpp behavior.
hector_dynamic_parameters.state: No RNG consumption, drift reset, time reset or synthetic sample on configuration. Offset contributes to total published bias and pseudo-AHRS. SetBias changes dynamic drift only; rate calibration preserves fixed offset.
hector_dynamic_parameters.measurement: native_measurement * scale_error + offset + updated_dynamic_drift + gaussian_noise * N(0,1)
hector_dynamic_parameters.yaw: ScaleError remains unused, matching source yawModel.update(dt); yaw white noise affects covariance but not pseudo-AHRS bias quaternion.
hector_dynamic_parameters.covariance: Acceleration/rate covariance retain startup GaussianNoise squared; orientation covariance follows current GaussianNoise, as in the source plugin.
hector_dynamic_parameters.scope: Each native stream contributes 30 same-stamp raw/output/bias samples after a runtime update, plus paused state transitions. No noise-distribution, motion or complete-migration claim.

managed_bridge.conversion_library: Installed official ros_gz_bridge 0.244.26; no modified conversion formulas or system libraries
managed_bridge.launch: bridge:=managed is now the default in SMB and RMF launches; bridge:=system selects the installed parameter_bridge
managed_bridge.scope: Project CLI message pairs and directions only; unsupported pairs/directions fail at startup. Official KeepLast10 and publisher/subscriber QoS override policies retained.
managed_bridge.shutdown: Signal handler sets a flag only. Close admission, await active conversions/publications, unsubscribe and release resources, then shut down ROS. Late callbacks retain only closed shared state. Conversion work remains outside the short gate mutex.
managed_bridge.old_failure: results/runtime_integration/renderer_launch.log retains the system bridge pthread assertion. No backtrace identifies its exact mutex; this is not a proven unique upstream root cause.
managed_bridge.evidence_scope: SMB2 confirms all expected active streams and independent clean bridge exit (~0.149s), but its later native-echo JSON parser failed and whole record remains failed. RMF1 fully passes, including native actuator receipt, independent clean exit (~0.120s) and native IMU after exit. SMB1 preserves the earlier fixture timeout waiting for legitimate absent chassis contact.

smb_native_background.mission: One search, one local exploration, one homing; original mine, native wheel dynamics, 512 internal renderer
smb_native_background.budgets: 500 vertices, 5000 edges, 20000 sampling rounds, 5m history/graph exclusion and 30s planning deadline unchanged
smb_native_background.cleanup: launch0, no node exit failures, no signal escalation or forced kill
smb_native_background.scope: Independent background counters, not total graph growth. One successful run, not a stability rate.
